scene: Kitchen counter on grocery day. One bowl of red apples sits at counter center-left and one bowl of green apples at center-right, both within Child's reach. Mom stands screen-left; Child stands screen-right. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot with both faces and the bowls visible.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: Child shows brief thinking focus while comparing; Mom offers facts evenly; both end with a light satisfied tone.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.start: The red-apple bowl sits at center-left and the green-apple bowl at center-right; Mom stands screen-left and Child screen-right with empty hands.
clips.action: Mom gestures toward both bowls with an open hand. Child looks from one bowl to the other and asks the difference; Mom gives a small sour face and a small sweet smile as she explains.
clips.end: Both bowls stay in place; Child keeps his hands empty, deciding.

clips.start: Both bowls stay in place; Child keeps his hands empty, deciding.
clips.action: Child points at the red bowl while giving his reason. Mom lifts one red apple and one green apple side by side to show the size; Child cups his own hands together while explaining why small fits him.
clips.end: Mom sets both apples back; Child's cupped hands open toward the red bowl.

clips.start: Mom sets both apples back; Child's cupped hands open toward the red bowl.
clips.action: Mom nods and steps back from the red bowl. Child picks red apples one at a time with his right hand and lines up four on the counter, counting softly with small taps.
clips.end: Four red apples stand in a line at counter center; the green bowl sits untouched; Mom has empty hands and a warm smile.
